request.query: Binomial theorem for two commuting elements in a noncommutative semiring.

items.name: Commute.add_pow'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {x y : R},
  Commute x y → ∀ (n : ℕ), (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, n.choose m.1 • (x ^ m.1 * y ^ m.2)

items.name: Commute.add_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {x y : R},
  Commute x y → ∀ (n : ℕ), (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * ↑(n.choose m)

items.name: Ring.add_choose_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : BinomialRing R] {r s : R} (k : ℕ),
  Commute r s → Ring.choose (r + s) k = ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal k, Ring.choose r ij.1 * Ring.choose s ij.2

items.name: add_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (x y : R) (n : ℕ),
  (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * ↑(n.choose m)

items.name: Commute.exists_add_pow_prime_pow_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {p : ℕ},
  Nat.Prime p → ∀ {x y : R}, Commute x y → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ r, (x + y) ^ p ^ n = x ^ p ^ n + y ^ p ^ n + ↑p * x * y * r

items.name: sub_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (x y : R) (n : ℕ),
  (x - y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1) ^ (m + n) * x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * ↑(n.choose m)

items.name: Fintype.sum_pow_mul_eq_add_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (ι : Type u_5) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (a b : R),
  ∑ s, a ^ s.card * b ^ (Fintype.card ι - s.card) = (a + b) ^ Fintype.card ι
